info.title: API.SH: Indian Railways
info.description: The Indian Railways API from API.SH: public Indian Railways data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
Where a train run is now: last station passed or reached, delay in minutes, expected times, distance covered, next stop, platform, update time, plus every halt with scheduled and expected arrival and departure, delays and whether it is passed. Before the run starts the stops carry the timetable. `date` is the day the train left its first station (today or the last 6 days, IST); or give `start_day` (0 = today, 1 = yesterday...).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/indian-rail-live-status

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: Start date of the run at its first station (YYYY-MM-DD, IST). Default today.

parameters.name: start_day
parameters.description: Alternative to date: 0 = started today, 1 = yesterday, up to 6.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
A train's full timetable: name and type, source and destination, days it runs, classes, indicative fares for the whole route, pantry, zone, coach order and every stop with arrival, departure, halt, distance, day, platform, zone, division and coordinates.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

get.description:
Every train between two Indian Railways stations (nearby stations of the same city included, e.g. NZM for NDLS): number, name and type, boarding and alighting station with platforms, departure, arrival, duration and day offset, distance and average speed, days it runs, classes, indicative fares per class (adult, child, Tatkal; INR), pantry, zone, validity dates and the coach order. Give `date` to keep only the trains running that day. Find station codes with /indian-rail/v1/stations.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/indian-rail-trains

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Boarding station code, e.g. NDLS (New Delhi), CSMT, HWH, SBC, MAS.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Destination station code, e.g. BCT (Mumbai Central).

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: Journey date (YYYY-MM-DD): only trains that run from the boarding station on that day, each marked `runs_on_date`.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Only this train type, e.g. RAJDHANI, SHATABDI, DURONTO, VANDE BHARAT, SUPERFAST, MAIL_EXPRESS, GARIB RATH.

parameters.name: exact
parameters.description: true: only trains from exactly `from` to exactly `to` (no nearby stations).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
